note: Cases mirror validate_dangling_config_refs: an @config.<key> no knob supplies (app, orbital, the trait, or any trait connected by @trait embeds in either direction), with controls for a pattern's self-named declaration default, guards (not collected), a self-forward declared by the embedder, path suffixes and malformed keys. Expectations are the compiler's findings on the same program (orb validate --json). The pattern registry is a hand-written subset of LINT_PATTERNS (prop names only matter).

findings.message: `@config.missing` — no trait in T's referrer chain declares config knob 'missing'; the forward cannot resolve and renders as the literal string
findings.suggestion: Declare `missing` on the owning trait (or its embedder) or remove the reference
